name: Advantech ADAM-6050 (12DI/6DO, Modbus TCP)
doc_revision: ADAM-6000 Series Ethernet-based Data Acquisition and Control Modules User Manual, January 2008, 3rd Edition, Appendix B.2.5 ADAM-6050/6050W
notes: Appendix B.2.5 lists reference numbers (DI 00001-00012 'Read', DO 00017-00022 R/W, counter/frequency 40001-40024). The manual's own examples are ambiguous about the on-wire address (FC02 example 'Read coil number 1 to 8 (address number 00001 to 00008)' is sent as '01 02 00 01 00 08'; FC01 example for 00017-00024 is '01 01 00 17 00 08'; FC06 example 'register 40002' is '01 06 00 02 ...'). Assumption: standard 1-based reference numbering, address_base=1, protocol address = number - 1 (DI 0..11, DO 16..21, counters 0..23). UNCERTAIN - if the device returns shifted data, set address_base to 0. DI are read with FC02 (the manual's FC02 example uses 00001-00008), DO with FC01/FC05. Counter registers: 2 words per channel, low word first (formula 'value of 40002 x 65535 + value of 40001'; the 65535 multiplier is as printed). Counter start/stop/clear coils (00033...), pulse output and 'All DI/DO value' words (40301/40303) are omitted because their layout in the extracted table was ambiguous. The manual excerpt read gives no default IP, port or unit ID, so the connection block only states TCP.

points.name: DI 0 Counter/Frequency
points.note: Only valid when the channel is configured as counter/frequency. Counter = high*65535 + low as printed in manual (probably 65536); frequency = low word / 10 Hz.
